notes: v2.21.0 — Notifications ab clickable hain (aap ki hidayat par): jo khabar jis cheez ki hai, us par click karein to seedha wahi screen khul jayegi — update ki khabar Settings par, missing Page ki khabar Missing Pages par (usi Page ke filter ke sath), scan ki khabar Scan Reports par, upload/timer/kam-videos ki khabar Upload Manager par, token ke masle ki khabar Connection Monitoring par. Click ke sath woh notification parha hua bhi mark ho jati hai. Note: purani notifications (is update se pehle ki) mein link nahi hoga — sirf nayi anay wali khabrein clickable hongi.
